digest.component_or_area: dev environment bootstrap and metrics analyzers
propositions: The dev bootstrap must explicitly name the metrics extra (lizard, scc, jscpd) to pin toolchain intent independently of CI rationale and prevent silent regression if the self-reference is trimmed.
Non-Python analyzers scc and jscpd cannot be installed via Python extras and require documented manual installation steps (brew install scc, npm install -g jscpd) in the local dev environment guide.
The metrics extra is already locked in uv.lock and transitively pulled by the dev extra, making the Makefile change behavior-preserving today but necessary as a hardening.

Absence of scc and jscpd must degrade gracefully to unavailable metrics rather than causing hard failures in rebar metrics, with lizard-backed complexity and jscpd-backed duplication still functional when available.
